copy.tagline_en: Create and structure packages in the Trezor Suite monorepo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create new packages or resolve cyclic dependencies in the Trezor Suite project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会指导你在 Trezor Suite monorepo 中创建和结构化包（package），包括选择作用域（如 @trezor、@suite-common 等）和避免循环依赖的建议。
howto.when: 当你询问如何创建新包、选择作用域，或遇到循环依赖问题时，Claude 会主动提供指导。

say.text: 包太大导致循环依赖怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会建议拆分出公共类型包，如 packageC。

say.text: 作用域有哪些？举个例子。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will guide you on creating and structuring packages in the Trezor Suite monorepo, including choosing scopes (e.g., @trezor, @suite-common) and avoiding cyclic dependencies.
howto.when_en: When you ask about creating a new package, choosing a scope, or resolving cyclic dependency issues, Claude will provide guidance.

say_en.text: How to create a new package?
say_en.note: Claude will give a command example like yarn generate-package @scope/name.

say_en.text: What if my package is too large and causes circular dependencies?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest splitting out common types into a new package.

say_en.text: What are the scopes? Give examples.
say_en.note: Claude will list @trezor, @suite-common and their folders.
